findings.issue: The new predicate keys on the stored basis (`_mio.gate_cleared(tests)`, i.e. gateBasis == `cleared`) rather than on the gate that actually measures the task. Its own docstring says 'the phase's own gate may be empty too', and in that state the defect the task describes ('A task can close with no gate while the record reads green') is still open by a second shape: a tdd/regression task whose own tests.gate is absent or [] with no basis falls back to its phase (`_manifest_io.gate_entries`, _manifest_io.py:685-692), an empty phase testGate is a designed, validator-accepted state (`_manifest_phases.py:791`, `phase add --gate-clear`), `run-test-gate` answers `empty-gate` with exit 0 (run-test-gate.py:5401-5420), and `done` closes it via `_close_gate`'s arm '%s declares no gate, nor does its phase, so its close rests on its commit alone' (audit-task.py:7289-7313) - `_owed_case_gate_refusal` returns None because gateBasis is not `cleared`. Judged by reading, not run.
findings.resolution: Ask the refusal at `done` (and, if wanted, at the writes) of the resolved gate: refuse when tests.mode is tdd/regression and `_mio.gate_entries(phase, node)[0]` is empty, which covers both the cleared gate and the fallback to an empty phase gate; add a case beside ocg8 with a tdd task carrying no own gate in a phase whose testGate is [] (and its gate-only second-direction pair).

findings.issue: On a STARTED task the scope refusal prints `_OWED_CASE_WRITE_REMEDY`, whose second half ('--tests-mode gate-only if it owes no case of its own') is itself refused: a tests.mode change on a started task is a narrowing `_narrowings` blocks (fg6 pins 'already been attempted'), unlike tests.gate which is `_FORWARD_ONLY`. The `done` arm already words its remedy for this ('A started task may still move its gate ... so the remedy is the gate and not the mode'); the scope arm does not, so e.g. `scope <started tdd task> --gate-clear` names a dead-end remedy.
findings.resolution: Pass `_started(node)`-dependent remedy text at the _locked_scope call site (the gate-only half only for a task not yet started), and pin it with a case on a started tdd task asserting '--tests-mode gate-only' is absent from the refusal.

findings.issue: User-visible behaviour changed and the surfaces describing `--gate-clear` still say it is how a task reaches the EMPTY gate ('`--gate-clear` for none'), with no mention that a tdd/regression task (including one whose mode `add` derived from its title) is now refused and must pass `--tests-mode gate-only`. The executor named this follow-up itself; it is outside the task's declared files.
findings.resolution: Add one sentence to each surface (or to verbs-in-full.md and point the others at it) stating the refusal and its two remedies, and a CHANGELOG entry for the new refusal.
